summary: Addentax Group Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into private placement agreements with three investors, including related parties, to issue 677,084 shares at $4.80 per share for gross proceeds of about $3.25 million. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. The placement relies on Regulation S exemption and shares are unregistered. The Audit Committee approved related-party subscriptions. This is a routine capital raise, not a special-situation event.
